name: Hiroshima (Japan)
description: A deep green field charged at the centre with three white wavy horizontal bars.
history: The three-bar emblem was adopted in 1896, drawing on the war banner associated with the lords of Hiroshima Castle; the bars are also read as the rivers of the Ōta delta on which the city stands.

features.symbolism: the three wavy bars, used as Hiroshima's emblem since 1896, derive from the banner of the feudal lords of Hiroshima Castle and evoke the branching rivers of the city's delta
